headline: Adopted Central Business District zoning changes, $350,495 and $138,795.50 fund transfers, and $15,350 library mold repair.
summary: The council adopted zoning changes for the Central Business District, including higher housing density limits. It approved transfers from reserve and budget accounts, including $15,350 for mold repair at the Derry Public Library and $350,495 for employee leave payouts. During public forum, a resident discussed property tax revenue lost along the Exit 4A highway project.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, including Ordinance #2026-002 on the commercial and industrial property tax exemption program, 6-0.
Adopted Ordinance #2026-001, changing zoning rules for the Central Business District, 6-0.
Approved withdrawing $15,350 from the Derry Public Library Capital Reserve Fund for mold remediation, 6-0.
Approved withdrawing $350,495 from the Compensated Absences Capital Reserve Fund for employee leave payouts, 6-0.
Approved transferring $26,522.23 to the PW Capital Reserve Fund for the Transfer Station solar project, 6-0.
Approved transferring $138,795.50 to the Derry Economic Development Expendable Trust Fund, 6-0.
Approved authorizing the Town Administrator to accept and spend a $9,000 grant from the US Alliance for Election Excellence, 6-0.
